claims.text: Existing works on quantifying uncertainty in LLM responses often overlook the complex nature of LLMs.
Existing works on quantifying uncertainty in LLM responses often overlook the uniqueness of in-context learning.
Predictive uncertainty in in-context learning stems from provided demonstrations as aleatoric uncertainty.
Predictive uncertainty in in-context learning stems from ambiguities tied to model configurations as epistemic uncertainty.
The proposed method offers an unsupervised way to quantify in-context learning prediction uncertainty in a plug-and-play fashion.
Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of decomposing in-context learning uncertainty into aleatoric and epistemic components.

evidence.description: Existing works have been devoted to quantifying the uncertainty in LLM's response, but they often overlook the complex nature of LLMs
such uncertainties may stem from both the provided demonstrations (aleatoric uncertainty)
...and ambiguities tied to the model's configurations (epistemic uncertainty).
The proposed method offers an unsupervised way to understand the prediction of in-context learning in a plug-and-play fashion.
Extensive experiments are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of the decomposition.

methodologies.name: Unsupervised Uncertainty Decomposition for In-Context Learning
methodologies.description: An unsupervised, plug-and-play estimation framework that quantifies and decomposes predictive uncertainty in in-context learning into aleatoric uncertainty from demonstrations and epistemic uncertainty from model configurations.

limitations.text: Existing uncertainty quantification works overlook the complex nature of LLMs and the uniqueness of in-context learning.
